summary: Repaired compiled runtime action casing and pre-validation admission, exact marked GoScript effect admission and frozen effect descriptors, and post-unmount stale tick snapshots. Focused runtime suite passes 11/11; generated-app/browser evidence is pending N6.

evidence.path_correction: The first N4 draft was mistakenly written to the independent XR-G-RUNTIME.md/json paths. Its bytes were preserved under coordination/reviews/history/N4-miswrite-XR-G-RUNTIME.md/json, and the original N3 XR review files were restored from the initial captured contents.
repaired_cases: Only the renderer's closed lowerCamel {path,event,value} action shape is accepted; PascalCase is rejected.
Own data descriptors, closed keys, symbols/accessors/prototype checks, and admission reservation prevent getter/proxy reentry from dispatching an inner transition.
Effects admit the exact marked GoScript gobi.Effect shape and reject missing marker, accessor, extra own property, and unsupported Name/Reply before effect-host calls.
Effects and host scripts enforce fixture.request with Name lookup and Reply complete.
Post-unmount stale actions preserve the last logical view, capture the renderer's actual empty DOM, and do not set runtime failure.

findings: PascalCase renderer action rejected at dispatch-input; zero Update calls.
Enumerable path getter reentered before busy reservation; nested and outer dispatch both accepted.
Post-unmount stale action returned accepted but appended no tick and set suppressed-action failure.

limits: Runtime tests use stub symbols and renderer APIs.
The inherited probe renderer throws from domSnapshot() after unmount; the repaired React renderer returns an empty physical-root snapshot, and runtime lifecycle coverage uses a matching test stub.
Four-app generated-JavaScript and mounted-browser conformance are pending N6; no integration success is claimed yet.
